subject: Clarification: incident notification windows & POC matrix (GreenFintech SIG)
messages:
From: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@greenfintech.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
Cc: Security Ops (GreenFintech) <sec-ops@greenfintech.com>, Legal (GreenFintech) <legal@greenfintech.com>

Subject: SIG follow-up: question on notification timing and POCs

Hi Mina,

Thanks for the SIG packet — our security team reviewed the incident response section and had a couple of follow-ups specific to notification timing and points of contact. Two quick questions:

1) For incidents that meet your criteria for customer notification, what is Redwood's target timeline to provide initial notification to affected customers? Is it 72 hours, 5 business days, or an SLA-dependent window?

2) We need a clear POC matrix we can include in our vendor intake (who to call, who to email, and which channels are guaranteed to be monitored off-hours). Can you share that matrix and confirm whether Redwood will notify our legal team separately for incidents that may trigger regulatory disclosure?

Appreciate any clarification — we are trying to finalize our SIG responses this week.

Best,
Tom
Tom Alvarez
Senior Security Engineer | GreenFintech

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@greenfintech.com>
Cc: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 16:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SIG follow-up: question on notification timing and POCs

Tom —

Thanks for the clear questions. Short answers up front, followed by detail and attachments:

- Initial customer notification: target is 72 hours from incident identification for incidents that meet our customer-notification thresholds. For cases involving legal/regulatory evaluation or where investigation findings are incomplete, we use a staged timeline (initial notice within 72 hours, followed by a detailed update within 10 business days).

- POC matrix: attached is "Redwood_IR_Roster_v2.xlsx" — it lists primary and secondary contacts for on-call IR, security ops, and legal escalation. Off-hours incidents: primary on-call security (pager) + dedicated incident mailbox (security-incidents@redwood.ai) are monitored 24/7.

Details:
- Threshold: our customer-notify threshold is any confirmed data exposure that affects confidentiality or integrity of customer data or a prolonged service-impacting outage that meets SLA-impacting criteria.
- The 72-hour window refers to initial notification acknowledging the event and next steps; it is not a promise of final root-cause or remediation timeline.
- We will loop in customer legal teams when an incident has potential regulatory disclosure implications; our legal team (listed on the roster) coordinates the formal notification wording and timing.

I attached both the roster and a short doc that maps SIG questions to our IR playbook excerpt ("SIG-answers-incident-response.docx"). Markus and Jonas are cc'ed for any additional legal nuances and SLAs.

If you want, we can hop on a 20-min call Monday to walk through the matrix and adjust contact methods for your intake process.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Senior Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_IR_Roster_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet), SIG-answers-incident-response.docx (doc)

Tom —

Quick legal note to add to Mina's helpful response:
- The 72-hour initial notice is Redwood's operational target, not a legally guaranteed SLA. For contractual language, our standard approach is to include a Mutual Notification Addendum (MNDA) that clarifies notification responsibilities and timing when customers require it.
- If GreenFintech prefers a firm contractual window, we can propose language in the MNDA; I attached a redline of our MNDA (see "MNDA_edit-track.pdf" in the shared drive link) for reference.

Jonas — please flag if the on-call routing or mailbox naming needs any adjustment to match your security intake.

Thanks,
Markus
Chief Legal Officer (interim)
Redwood Inference

Hi Mina / Markus —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the roster. Couple follow-ups before we mark the SIG answer as cleared:

1) For clarity, will the initial 72-hour notice be sent to a single security mailbox (security-incidents@redwood.ai) and to the primary POC, or will it also be delivered to a distribution that includes GreenFintech legal? In other words, should we plan to include our legal team in that initial notification or only on a follow-up when regulatory impact is confirmed?

2) For off-hours incident escalation, does Redwood have a sustained incident comms channel (e.g., dedicated PagerDuty escalation path + Slack DM bridge) that GreenFintech can rely on for continuous updates beyond the initial notice? We need to map our on-call flows to yours.

If you can confirm both items and share the preferred escalation sequence (primary -> secondary -> legal -> exec on-call), we'll close out the SIG section for IR.

Cheers,
Security Ops
GreenFintech

Hi —

Answers below so you can finalize the SIG responses:

1) Initial 72-hour notice: we will send the initial acknowledgement and high-level facts to the security-incidents@redwood.ai mailbox and the primary customer POC listed on the roster. We do not automatically include customer legal in the initial notice unless the customer requests it. If GreenFintech prefers legal on first notice, we will include your legal distribution proactively — just tell us the address to add.

2) Off-hours escalation & sustained comms: Redwood uses a PagerDuty-based escalation for on-call security + a dedicated incident Slack channel (partners-incidents@redwood) that stays open for the life of the incident. The escalation order we recommend and have reflected in the attached roster: primary security on-call -> secondary security -> security-incidents mailbox -> legal on-call -> executive on-call. We can map exact PagerDuty escalation IDs during the intake call.

Next steps:
- I'll send a short calendar invite for Monday 11/16 10:00 AM PT to walk the matrix and confirm whether you want legal included on initial notices.
- If you decide you need a contractual notification window, Markus can propose MNDA language; DocuSign link provided here: https://docusign.net/Redwood/GF-MNDA-2026

Thanks,
Mina
